title: CIA declassified Arc Light mission records, 18 June – 15 November 1965
citation: Appendix I, 'ARC LIGHT MISSIONS: 18 June 1965 – 15 November 1965' (CIA-RDP78S02149R000100060004-0) and Appendix IV, 'Analysis of ARC LIGHT Program by Target Zone' with Figure 1 strike map, 17 June – 15 November 1965 (CIA-RDP78S02149R000100060013-0). Approved for release 31 August 2001, CIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.
notes: The complete B-52 strike record for the war's first five months: 1,153 sorties (June 30, July 151, August 177, September 327, October 297, 1-15 November 171), across 74 numbered missions. Appendix IV assigns every mission a UTM grid square. Tay Ninh Province, and Nui Ba Den with it, lies in grid square XT. CHECKED IN DETAIL 2026-09-03: there was no Arc Light strike in grid square XT between CAR PARK II on 21 July and THIRD BASE on 2 September 1965, and the missions flown in late August fell in other squares entirely - HOSE REEL I and II (26 and 27 August) in YT, GEAR TRAIN I and II (23 and 28 August) in BS. This rules out a B-52 strike as the mechanism of the '450 civilians' day on a tighter argument than absence from a map: it rests on a grid-square assignment for every mission in the period. An earlier version of this note said the strikes near Tay Ninh were only CAT PAW I-VI and FINE SAND, 28 October to 14 November; that was incomplete - XT strikes resumed on 2 September and ran heavily through the autumn - though all of them postdate Larry's departure and the conclusion is unchanged. Mission 33, FAR STAR, 26-27 September 1965, is the strike reported in Pacific Stars and Stripes on 29 September as the war's 33rd, placed 15 miles northeast of Tay Ninh City.
